programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won't find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today's world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: E9

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.desc: The Seine is mainly known through Paris, which nevertheless represents only 13 km of its total length of 775 km. Meet the people who shape today's Seine and bear witness to its past. The journey begins in Conflans-Sainte-Honorine, in the Yvelines department, and continues to the English Channel, in Le Havre, Seine-Maritime.

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 《山河之影》改編自路陽執導的同名系列電影《繡春刀》，講述兩位少年以赤子情懷協力衝破人生困境的江湖故事。 建文三年，雞鵝巷的小賊李霧濟南府金事王克恭攜萬貫家財平調進入南京城，便盜錦衣百戶李東方之名帖潛入王克恭府夢想著順利盜寶，在一夜之間坐擁菜華富貴。不料王克恭府中暗流湧動，李霧被迫捲入了一場圍繞魚瞑鎖展開的前朝火器之爭中，原本作為局外人的李霧成為了魚瞑鎖的持有者，陷入了漩渦中心。兒時，將李霧詔獄中解救的孩童宋真如今已成為錦衣衛陸錚，與李霧成了同僚，相見不相認；和李霧曾同處個囚室的女童舒棠變成了夜不收刺客，並跟李霧成了間諜夫妻，共同完成夜不收的任務。朝野紛爭的陰暗與殘酷讓三人之間的感情也在連環鎖樣的陰暗中經受著考驗。當改朝換代的那一刻到來的時候，所有的戰事和未解的迷局，都將落下帷幕。

Stars in Focus: Lau Ching Wan: Dealer Healer
programme.desc: This is a true story based on a repented gangster preaching the word of God and guiding his brotherhood to turn over a new leaf. Chen once was the leader of the famous gang “The 13 Tsz Wan Shan”, he lost his family, lovers, brothers and finally ended up imprisoned for his drug abuse and trafficking. After jail, he devoted himself to save the lost fellows and was selected as “The JCI Hong Kong Ten Outstanding Young Persons”. Being respected by the world, Chen is always asked to solve the most difficult situations between evil and good. People give him a nickname “The Fixer”. However, there are two sides of a coin, Chen can work out any problem of others, he does not know how to deal with his personal knot with his love, with whom he has had guilty conscience all his life. Can he fix it eventually?

programme.title: Ne Zha 2 (Cantonese Dubbed)
programme.desc: Ne Zha returns again joining by versatile stars - Jennifer Yu, Fish Liew and Peter Chan, who bring their unique voices and witty dialogue to the adventures of Ne Zha and Ao Bing and breathe a new life into the story. After the heavenly lightning, although Ne Zha and Ao Bing survived by becoming spirits, they would soon dissipate completely. Taiyi plans to rebuild Ne Zha and Ao Bing's mortal bodies with the Seven-colored Precious Lotus. However, during the process of reconstruction, numerous obstacles arise. Together, they embark on a new journey to challenge their fate.

programme.title: Director’s Premiere -Lawrence Kan
programme.desc: 'In Broad Daylight', written and directed by emerging filmmaker Lawrence Kan, has garnered 16 nominations at the 42nd Hong Kong Film Awards. From the formative impact of films experienced in childhood to his adult pursuit of human connection through the lens of a camera, Lawrence's enduring curiosity about people has allowed him to witness the struggles of ordinary individuals-and, through a journey of being lost and learning to wait, to ultimately find his own voice. Let's follow this interview into Lawrence's inner world and listen to his pure passion and unwavering dedication to films.
